name: Robert M. Place
reason: Too thin under the rules, though clearly in scope (tarot artist and historian, Saugerties NY, email alchemicaltarot@aol.com on robertmplacetarot.com/about/, which also names Omega). His books and decks are sold directly by email/PayPal/Gumroad with no ISBNs on his own site (Macmillan's page refuses our robots.txt, 403), so no book can be listed; he has no YouTube channel of his own; his only upcoming class page item is a 4-day Omega workshop (12-15 Oct 2027) whose description promises 'improvements in health, prosperity, and wellbeing' (borderline health claim, left out), and the Tarot at the Met session (24 Nov 2026) is marked filled. That leaves two free resources (Alchemical Tarot Reimagined LWB PDF, workshop handouts). For the owner: a listing is possible if the Omega workshop and his deck-and-book sets ($40-$60) are accepted as offerings.
